title: bn254-gt-dlp: (6,2) STNFS on a twisted base field behind a run gate: expected work 2^92.798994784659

claims.statement: For the full production bn254-gt-dlp target, proof.md's algorithm (run gate, section 1, field-map.md, the STNFS core of proof.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns x with g^x = z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT, at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64) 2^93.9768586204 < 2^92.798994784659 units (C = 20,000 scalar AArch64 instructions): an expectation over the challenge and the coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. The attack first draws a 64-bit word v and stops as a failure (under one unit) unless v < K = 8153561984748232693, the least K with (K/2^64) x 0.882342 >= 0.39. Past the gate it succeeds with probability at least 0.882342, costs at most 2^106.0000636778 units (both logarithms metered at 2^106) and at most 2^93.9768586204 in expectation (the two logarithms at their expected work 2^93.684, H5; the other rows at bounds that hold in every run; collection and the matrix size at measured means + 2 SE, H3, H4). Nothing is amortized over other targets or runs. Analytic exploratory claim.
